column3: They took the Stars.\nNow Mercury is lit.\nCan I trust you?{end_wait}
Jenna and Kraden\nare hostages.\nHelp us get them back.{end_wait}
I swore to protect\nthis lighthouse.\nAnd I failed.{end_wait}
Then help us.\nWe can save them.{end_wait}
You're right.\nNo more arguing.{page_break}I'll follow Menardi.\nYou stop Saturos.{end_wait}
I judged you wrong.\nI'm sorry, Isaac.{end_wait}
Menardi has the\nhostages. I'll go\nbefore she escapes.{end_wait}
Be careful, Mia.\nJenna is with her.{end_wait}
I know. Keep Saturos\nhere. I'll bring\nthem back.{end_wait}
I won't let her\nleave without a fight.{end_wait}
The healer is gone.\nNow face me.{end_wait}
